status: approved by the owner on 2026-10-17 (recommended by a Fable review); applies from formal R2 onward

base.unchanged: R0.1 stays as is: every tolerance value, reference, fixture and the R1 pass condition. R0.2 only adds the rules below.

update_comparison.applies_to: Rust training against a Python/Torch reference for the full model: formal R2 (one update, eight updates, mature-state import) and later
gates: loss at every update: normalized_loss for update 1, eight_step_loss for later updates

gradients at every update: raw (before clip) and clipped gradients of all trainable tensors, the global norm and the clip coefficient, under the R0.1 gradient rule (elementwise atol/rtol, plus the relative L2 over all tensors together or the zero-reference L2)

parameters after an update: one_step_parameter after update 1, eight_step_parameter after later updates, compared only on elements whose reference (Torch) clipped gradient magnitude is at least K*eps at every update made in the comparison run up to and including the compared one
first and second moments after an update: first_moment and second_moment on all elements (no exclusion)
same-backend resume: byte-exact, unchanged from R0.1
update_comparison.rationale: AdamW divides by sqrt(v)+eps, so the first-update sensitivity of a parameter to its gradient is lr*eps/(|g|+eps)^2; it is about lr/eps where |g| is near eps and small where |g| >= 10*eps. The threshold follows from this formula, not from fitting results.
records_required: the number (as a fraction of all trainable elements), tensor names and indices of excluded parameter elements per compared update

post-update forward outputs (normalized quantiles) compared against the reference, recorded but not judged elementwise; forward is judged only through the next update's loss; after the last update, record the forward on the batch used for that update
update_comparison.stop_rule: if more than 10% of elements are excluded at any compared update on real data, stop and investigate before accepting the result

evidence.setup: R2P step 4 artificial fixture, float32 vs float64 Torch as a proxy for Rust-float32 vs Torch-float32

results.mature_import_64_updates_one_update: 0 failing without exclusion (max 7.2e-7 against atol 1e-6); 0 failing with K=10
results.moments_all_elements: 0 failing after one update, eight updates and the mature import (max diff first 8.7e-9, second 1.6e-12)
results.clip_note: the clip coefficient is 1 on this fixture, so raw and clipped gradients are equal; real data may differ and the clipped gradient is the one used

mask_definition.gradient_used: the reference clipped gradient, i.e. the gradient handed to AdamW
mask_definition.eight_updates: for the comparison after update k, an element is judged only if the condition holds at each of updates 1..k
mask_definition.mature_import: after importing a mature state (step 4096) and making one update, only that update's gradient is used; the updates before the import are not run in the comparison
mask_definition.moments_not_masked: m and v depend only on the gradient and are not amplified by the division by sqrt(v)+eps; the evidence shows them within tolerance on all elements

R1_gate_for_formal_R2.R1_status: unchanged: one cumulative intermediate element (train-last/blocks.1/index3450) is still unmet; R1 is not declared passed
R1_gate_for_formal_R2.formal_R2_entry: numeric: R1 final outputs (normalized and physical quantiles, all 7 fixed cases) within R0.1, and all 385 same-input local comparisons within R0.1; non-numeric: the other R1 scope items of R0.1 (isolated build, backend/lock and dependency license inventory, CPU compile, artificial nonfinite/mask/quantile-ordering cases) remain required and their status is confirmed and recorded before formal R2
R1_gate_for_formal_R2.intermediate_condition: the cumulative intermediate comparison remains required and recorded for every run, as a diagnostic; it no longer blocks formal R2
R1_gate_for_formal_R2.rationale: the unmet difference (2.74e-6 against a limit of 2.57e-6 on a value of 0.028) comes from upstream accumulation with zero same-input local difference, is of the same order as the training tolerances (gradient atol 2e-5, eight-update parameter atol 3e-6), and no principled general fix exists; keeping it as a gate would stop the practical validation indefinitely
R1_gate_for_formal_R2.not_changed: no element is excluded, no tolerance is widened, no reference is regenerated, and product equivalence is still judged separately

real_data_training: formal R2 (CARE fold0 train-prefix: one update, eight updates, mature step4096 import) may run once when the entry conditions hold; all other real-data training (more seeds, longer training, recalibration, other folds) stays stopped; R0.1 current_execution is unchanged
